articles.title: Former Hack VC partner Hsin-Ju Chuang found dead following public dispute with the firm
articles.snippet: The crypto community is seeking answers after 37-year-old growth executive Hsin-Ju Chuang was found dead in a remote California desert vehicle.

articles.title: Democrats 'chose visceral hatred for' Donald Trump over crypto Clarity Act, Lummis says
articles.snippet: Senator Cynthia Lummis said the crypto industry should "pin it on the Democrats" in her first public remarks after last week's failed Clarity Act vote.

articles.title: ESMA to prioritize EU-wide AI and tokenization supervision in 2027
articles.snippet: National regulators will map client-facing uses of the technologies, check a subset of firms and develop common approaches to oversight.

articles.title: Republican senator calls for probe into US presidents’ sons, citing crypto ventures
articles.snippet: Many Democrats have previously called for investigations into the Trump family’s crypto ventures, but now a Republican is asking for an inquiry based on ties to the presidency.

articles.title: Anthropic’s New Claude Opus 5.5 Matches Fable at 60% the Price
articles.snippet: Anthropic's new flagship claims Fable 5.1-level performance at a fraction of the cost—but GPT-6 Astra still beats it on two published benchmarks.
